View 3580 19th Ave W V6S 1C4 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 2 bed, 1 bath, 650 Sq. Ft. apartment. 3580 19th Ave W is currently on market.
This newly renovated 2 bed 1.5 fully furnished unit Located in one of best neighborhoods Dunbar , 5 min drive to grocery stores, restaurants and parks, 7 min to Spanish bank & Jericho beach, 10 min to UBC and 15 min to downtown Vancouver. Top school catchment (Lord Byng Secondary and Lord Kitchener Elementary) and close to top private schools including St. George's, Crafton House, West Point Grey Academy, St. John's, all within 10 min drive. This house has new paint throughout, new hard floor, brand new IKEA furniture, private laundry, rent includes all, no extra cost, Very bright and clean . No pets no smoking . One year lease to start. Available 01 Aug 2026
